phases.rule: Use a named profile only to identify the runtime. Unknown names fall back to the neutral unknown profile. A profile never grants capabilities or write trust. Runtime writes require an explicit ledger-backed workspace-owner choice and a successful controller writer probe.
Report only capabilities verified in the active runtime session. Do not infer capabilities from a runtime name.
Load only the user-owned workspace that was explicitly selected or previously verified.
Detect pending wrap-up state and the newest durable checkpoint before reporting readiness.
Optional integrations may improve capability but may not block basic startup.

mode_behavior.quick: Use only already-loaded verified context. The executable requires an explicit confirmation that current context is loaded.
mode_behavior.regular: Load or verify current durable workspace state before task work begins.
mode_behavior.degraded_offline: Mark state stale, explain what cannot be verified, and avoid durable writes.
mode_behavior.wrap_up: Persist a replay-safe transaction, route durable changes according to core/state_routes.json, create a final checkpoint, and verify before completion.
